coverageDefinition: Every figure in the pinned report for each listed target/component was individually displayed and visually assessed, including one app plane beyond each changed extent. Panel totals are not unique native sections.

components.finding: Thin roof-side notches at X173-179/Y291-296/Z181-182 lie in bright lumen and leave the gray roof outside the trial.
Tapering bright-lumen deficit at X167-172/Y293-298/Z183-184; residual unlabelled lumen at the ends is not resolved by this candidate.
Curved wall-side strip at X191-192/Y309-310/Z153-160 remains inside bright cavity without gross inclusion of the adjacent gray band. Nearby C288 and other components require union assessment.

Cavity-floor strip at X204-207/Y282-288 corresponds to bright lumen at Z140 and continuity with Z141. Dark tissue below remains outside; the isolated section outline is not itself evidence of erroneous tissue inclusion.
Oblique bright wall-side strip at X235-236/Y213-219/Z185-194 remains separate from neighbouring dark tissue. Nearby C326 still requires combined-outline review.

Lower wall-side strip at X211-212/Y309-310/Z143-150 stays on the bright side of the gray wall. Existing fragmented outlines and residual cavity beyond the trial remain; no automatic full-lumen filling is inferred.

Step-shaped deficits at X166-173/Y299-304/Z179-180 lie in the bright lumen near its tapering edge. Residual bright cavity beyond the candidate remains; existing fragmented outlines do not define anatomical tissue boundaries.
Curved wall-side strip at X167-171/Y323-324/Z149-160 stays on the bright cavity side of the gray outer wall. Nearby lateral-wall candidates still require combined-outline assessment.
Sloping cavity-wall notch at X187-192/Y307-308/Z161-166 is supported by bright lumen on the corresponding orthogonal planes; the adjacent gray tissue edge remains outside the trial outline.
Lower wall-side strip at X221-224/Y317-318/Z141-148 stays inside bright lumen, while gray tissue remains outside. Nearby C194 requires union review; this does not label the remaining distal cavity.
Long bright cavity-side strip at X219-220/Y316 tapering across orthogonal planes; no gross wall inclusion seen. This lies adjacent to C222, so individual support is not a combined-outline decision.

Gap beneath the existing strip at X227 and wall-side deficit across Y261-272/Z195-198 are within bright lumen. Small neighbouring existing label islands and further unlabelled lumen remain; filling all surrounding bright pixels is not justified by this review.

Tip-side gaps at X165-170/Y319-325/Z139-140 lie within bright lumen, including gaps near small existing isolated label portions. The bright cavity extends beyond the trial; its anatomical termination is not established by this candidate.

Thin roof-side strip at X165-168/Y237-256/Z199-200 remains on the bright side of the wall; X167 has a long one-layer deficit. Z201 contains bright unlabelled lumen outside this candidate, not evidence that this repair completes the cavity.

Curved wall-side strip at X171-174/Y321-322, with orthogonal bright-lumen additions and no gross inclusion of the gray outer wall. Nearby C135/C166 and other candidates still require union assessment.

Roof-side notches at X167-176/Y287-296 and bright-lumen strip at Z185-186; no gross gray-wall inclusion seen. The unlabelled bright cavity beyond the trial, including Z187, remains outside this repair candidate.

Roof-side strip at X166-174/Y275-284/Z191-192 lies in the bright lumen. Existing small isolated label outlines at the lateral edge are not themselves evidence of tissue; trial support comes from the raw lumen. Other residual tip deficits remain.

Longer cavity-side deficit at X209 and Y306-308 tapers in neighbouring planes; Z144-156 additions remain on the bright side of the dark wall. No gross wall crossing seen; does not resolve the neighbouring unlabelled cavity extent.
Roof-side notches across X166-175/Y263-280, with a larger bright-lumen deficit at Z193. The gray roof remains outside; the bright tip beyond the candidate is still incompletely labelled.

Oblique wall-side bright strip at X233-234/Y215-227/Z183-199. Adjacent dark tissue foci stay outside the trial outline; no gross crossing into them was seen. This is not a histological classification of those foci.

Curved cavity-wall deficit at Y313-314, including the longer strip at X185-186; orthogonal additions lie in the bright lumen and retain the gray outer wall. Nearby candidate effects remain a separate union review.
Curved cavity-side strip at Y317-318 with corresponding notches across X171-180 and Z147-164; the gray outer wall remains outside. Nearby C166 and other components require combined review.
Cavity-side strip at Y319-320, including a longer deficit at X175-176; bright lumen supports individual addition, but the combined effect with C135 is not established by individual views.
Cavity-side deficit at X178; adjacent dark oblique tissue remains outside the trial outline.
Concavity at X180 and wall-side strip in orthogonal planes; adjacent small wall tissue remains outside.
White cavity-floor strip at X217; no gross inclusion of gray wall tissue in reviewed orthogonal planes.
Oblique cavity-wall deficit; trial does not bridge across the tissue protrusion near Y269.
Narrow bright lumen at X273-274; additions remain in its bright interior in all displayed planes. Unlabelled cavity beyond the candidate remains, including X275; not a completed cavity mask.
Step-shaped gaps within narrow bright lumen at X273-274; no gross wall crossing in orthogonal views. The unlabelled lumen at X275 is not repaired by this component.
Notches at X165-170 and gap between existing label regions at Z197-198 lie within a continuous bright lumen. Local connection is supported by visible lumen, not by a requirement to join labels.
Step-shaped wall-side deficits at X165-170/Y321-322 remain inside the bright cavity; the outer gray boundary remains outside the trial outline.

disposition: All 31 components (867 candidate voxels) have complete individual image review in the pinned 285 figures / 745 app panels. Retain as candidates pending combined-neighbour effects and finite-voxel raw-image support. No patch or adoption authority is provided by this record.
limitations: No histological identity assigned to small wall protrusions from these crops.
App-grid difference views do not replace native-image finite-volume support checks.
Residual cavity deficits outside these 31 components, including candidates smaller than 20 voxels and deficits beyond the one-layer inventory, remain unresolved here.
This is not human expert review or ground truth.
